bullets_en: ‘Sorry, it is not our TV’: NoBroker Packers fined ₹55K after carton goes missing.

bullets_ur: NoBroker Packers par 55 hazaar rupay jurmana, carton gum honay ke baad company ne kaha ‘yeh hamara TV nahi’

BJP ne Rahul Gandhi ki leadership par sawalat uthaye hain jabke INDIA bloc ka ijlas ho raha hai.
Brazil ke Lula ne 'dakhal-andazi' par tanqeed ki, pehle mustasmar mulkon mein, Trump ka naam liye baghair.
